assessment: Standalone observation tower with its own municipal admission, hours and visitor capacity. No parent Park found in the PDE search. The ground-floor telephone museum is part of this visitor site; it is not a separate standalone entry.

duplicateChecks.note: Torre Panorâmica Park search also yielded the unrelated Julianatoren in the Netherlands; excluded by identity and country.

officialObservations.address: Rua Professor Lycio Grein de Castro Vellozo, 191, Mercês, Curitiba, Paraná
officialObservations.hours: Daily 10:00–18:00; first Wednesday of month starts 12:00 for maintenance. May close early in busy periods.
officialObservations.accessibility: Audio description, viewing instruments adapted for wheelchair users, relief map. No unverified claim that the full route is step-free.
features: 360-degree city and Serra do Mar view

scopeNotes: Only the municipal listing supports the published prices and hours; the schedule ends on 31 December 2026 because the listing ends then.
The public profile intentionally does not promise complete wheelchair access beyond the aids documented by the city.
